notes.refusal_code_deviation: Brief asks the reflow to refuse a missing face metric typed first_baseline_metric_unavailable:<kind>. hsk-studio-interop-layout tests/layout_reflow_folio_export.rs:268-271 (not this lane's path) pins a CapHeight IDML frame shaped by FixedAdvanceShaper (no face metrics) to Err(LayoutError::UnsupportedComposition) / refusal() 'unsupported_composition'. A new LayoutError variant would fail that pin in the bundled run. So the reflow keeps unsupported_composition and the typed reason is ShapedParagraph::first_baseline_metric(kind) -> Err(FirstBaselineUnavailable) whose code() is first_baseline_metric_unavailable:<kind> (tests/frame_autosize.rs missing_face_metric_refuses_typed). Switching the reflow to a dedicated variant is one line in threaded_reflow.rs once the interop-layout pin owner updates that assertion: lead decision.
notes.type_api_request: Type's public API exposes no OS/2 metrics (provider::ttf is a private module; Face::capital_height/x_height are not reachable from layout). Requested signatures for the type owner: Run::cap_height_pt(&self) -> Option<f64> and Run::x_height_pt(&self) -> Option<f64> (OS/2 sCapHeight / sxHeight of the resolved face x font_size_pt / units_per_em; None without OS/2 v2+). Until then from_type fills only em_box_pt (first run's font size) and hosts with face access call ShapedParagraph::with_face_metrics(font_size_pt, units_per_em, cap_height, x_height).
